president.t:
n. 总统，主席
n. 校长；总裁

e.en: The {president} addressed the nation on live television.
e.zh: 总统通过电视直播向全国发表讲话。

e.en: She was elected {president} of the student council.
e.zh: 她当选为学生会主席。

e.en: She {announced} her resignation in a short email.
e.zh: 她在一封简短的邮件中宣布了辞职。

e.en: The airline {announced} a delay of two hours.
e.zh: 航空公司宣布航班延误两小时。

sweeping.t:
adj. 影响广泛的；彻底的
n. 清扫

e.en: The new law brought {sweeping} changes to healthcare policy.
e.zh: 新法律为医疗政策带来了广泛的变革。

e.en: She is {sweeping} the leaves off the front porch.
e.zh: 她正在清扫前门廊上的落叶。

reforms.t: n./v. 改革（reform 的复数/第三人称单数）

e.en: The new healthcare {reforms} take effect next January.
e.zh: 新的医疗改革将于明年一月生效。

e.en: He {reforms} every system he touches at the company.
e.zh: 他在公司接手的每个系统都会被他改革一遍。

e.en: The whole {nation} watched the World Cup final on television.
e.zh: 全国人民都在电视上观看世界杯决赛。

e.en: Climate change is a challenge facing every {nation} today.
e.zh: 气候变化是当今每个国家都面临的挑战。

tax.t:
n. 税；税款
v. 征税；使负担重

e.en: The new payment {system} processes thousands of transactions per second.
e.zh: 新的支付系统每秒能处理数千笔交易。

e.en: My immune {system} took a hit after that long flight.
e.zh: 经过那趟长途飞行,我的免疫系统受到了打击。

marking.t:
n. 标记；斑纹
v. 标记（mark 进行式）

e.en: The teacher spent the weekend {marking} exam papers.
e.zh: 老师整个周末都在批改考卷。

e.en: A faint {marking} on the map showed the buried treasure.
e.zh: 地图上一个淡淡的标记指出了埋藏宝藏的位置。

most.t:
adj. 大多数的
adv. 最

e.en: {Most} students finished the exam before time was up.
e.zh: 大多数学生在时间结束前就做完了考试。

e.en: This is the {most} useful app I've installed all year.
e.zh: 这是我今年装过最有用的应用。

e.en: There has been {significant} progress on the climate bill.
e.zh: 气候法案取得了重大进展。

e.en: She gave him a {significant} look across the table.
e.zh: 她隔着桌子意味深长地看了他一眼。

overhaul.t:
v. 彻底检修；全面改革
n. 大修

e.en: The company plans a complete {overhaul} of its mobile app.
e.zh: 公司计划对手机应用进行彻底改版。

e.en: Mechanics will {overhaul} the engine before the long road trip.
e.zh: 长途旅行前，技师会把发动机彻底大修一遍。

e.en: Smartphones have transformed daily life over the past {decade}.
e.zh: 智能手机在过去十年彻底改变了日常生活。

e.en: She spent a {decade} working as a foreign correspondent.
e.zh: 她做了十年的驻外记者。

e.en: {Critics} loved the show's witty dialogue and pacing.
e.zh: 评论家们喜爱这部剧机智的对白和节奏。

e.en: The policy has its {critics} on both sides of the aisle.
e.zh: 这项政策在两党中都有反对者。

e.en: World leaders quickly moved to {denounce} the violent attack.
e.zh: 各国领导人迅速谴责了这起暴力袭击事件。

e.en: She used her speech to {denounce} corruption in the government.
e.zh: 她借演讲谴责政府中的腐败行为。

changes.t:
n. 变化（复数）
v. change 的第三人称单数

e.en: The team {changes} its strategy after every loss.
e.zh: 球队每次失利后都会调整战术。

e.en: Several {changes} were made to the original draft.
e.zh: 原稿做了几处修改。

disproportionately.t: adv. 不成比例地；过度地

e.en: The pandemic affected low-income workers {disproportionately}.
e.zh: 疫情对低收入工人造成的影响过于严重。

e.en: Older users are {disproportionately} targeted by phone scams.
e.zh: 老年用户尤其容易成为电话诈骗的目标。

e.en: The charity is {benefiting} families across the entire region.
e.zh: 这个慈善机构正在惠及整个地区的家庭。

e.en: Remote work is {benefiting} parents with young children.
e.zh: 远程办公正在让有小孩的父母受益。

e.en: Only the most {wealthy} families could afford private tutors.
e.zh: 只有最富裕的家庭才请得起私人家教。

e.en: He retired {wealthy} after selling his startup.
e.zh: 卖掉创业公司后，他富有地退休了。

e.en: Concerned {citizens} gathered to protest the new law.
e.zh: 忧心的市民们聚集起来抗议这项新法律。

e.en: All {citizens} must carry a valid ID card.
e.zh: 所有公民都必须随身携带有效身份证。

accusing.t:
adj. 责备的
v. 指控中

e.en: He shot her an {accusing} look across the room.
e.zh: 他从房间另一头投来责备的目光。

e.en: Stop {accusing} me of things I didn't do.
e.zh: 别再指责我没做过的事了。

administration.t:
n. 管理；行政
n. 政府；当局

e.en: The new {administration} promised tax cuts for small businesses.
e.zh: 新政府承诺为小企业减税。

e.en: School {administration} sent an email about updated policies.
e.zh: 学校行政部门发邮件通知了新政策。

e.en: He led a {profligate} lifestyle and went bankrupt at thirty.
e.zh: 他生活挥霍无度，三十岁就破产了。

e.en: The team was {profligate} with chances and lost the match.
e.zh: 球队浪费了大量机会，最终输掉了比赛。

e.en: Influencers often run {giveaways} to grow their followers.
e.zh: 网红经常通过赠品活动来增加粉丝。

e.en: The conference offered free t-shirt {giveaways} at the entrance.
e.zh: 会议在入口处发放免费T恤等赠品。

e.en: I'd like a coffee {and} a croissant, please.
e.zh: 请给我一杯咖啡和一个牛角包。

e.en: She studied hard {and} eventually passed the exam.
e.zh: 她努力学习，最终通过了考试。

e.en: The government imposed {austerity} measures to cut the deficit.
e.zh: 政府实施紧缩措施以削减赤字。

e.en: She admired the quiet {austerity} of Japanese tea rooms.
e.zh: 她欣赏日式茶室那种宁静的简朴。

e.en: She walked {toward} the exit without looking back.
e.zh: 她头也不回地朝出口走去。

e.en: His attitude {toward} learning has changed dramatically.
e.zh: 他对学习的态度发生了巨大变化。

middle.t:
n. 中间，中部
adj. 中间的

e.en: She sat in the {middle} seat of the row.
e.zh: 她坐在那一排的中间位置。

e.en: The phone rang in the {middle} of dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭吃到一半电话响了。

e.en: I have a math {class} at nine tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 我明天早上九点有一节数学课。

e.en: This restaurant attracts a wealthy {class} of customers.
e.zh: 这家餐厅吸引着富裕阶层的顾客。

e.en: Many {families} gather for dinner during the holidays.
e.zh: 许多家庭在节日里聚在一起吃晚餐。

e.en: Different language {families} share common ancestral roots.
e.zh: 不同的语系拥有共同的祖先根源。

e.en: I've {already} finished the report you asked for.
e.zh: 你要的报告我已经写完了。

e.en: Is it {already} midnight? Time flew tonight.
e.zh: 已经半夜了吗?今晚时间过得真快。

burdened.t: adj. 负担沉重的；受累的

e.en: She felt {burdened} by the responsibility of caring for her parents.
e.zh: 照顾父母的责任让她感到压力很大。

e.en: The donkey was {burdened} with sacks of grain.
e.zh: 那头驴驮着一袋袋谷物。

rising.t:
v. 上升中（rise 的现在分词）
adj. 上升的；新兴的

e.en: She's a {rising} star in the tech industry.
e.zh: 她是科技行业里崭露头角的明星。

e.en: Sea levels are {rising} faster than scientists predicted.
e.zh: 海平面上升速度比科学家预测的还快。

costs.t:
n. 费用（复数）
v. 花费（第三人称单数）

e.en: Rising fuel {costs} are affecting small businesses.
e.zh: 不断上涨的燃料成本正在影响小企业。

e.en: This new printer {costs} less than the old model.
e.zh: 这台新打印机比旧型号便宜。

e.en: {Proponents} of the new bill say it will create jobs.
e.zh: 这项新法案的支持者表示它能创造就业机会。

e.en: Early {proponents} of electric cars were once mocked by industry experts.
e.zh: 电动汽车的早期支持者曾被业内专家嘲笑。

counter.t:
n. 柜台；计数器
v. 反驳

e.en: Please pay at the {counter} near the entrance.
e.zh: 请在入口附近的柜台付款。

e.en: The new policy runs {counter} to public expectations.
e.zh: 新政策与公众的期望背道而驰。

that.t:
pron. 那个
conj. 引导从句

e.en: I can't believe {that} she finished the marathon.
e.zh: 我真不敢相信她跑完了那场马拉松。

e.en: Could you pass me {that} blue notebook on the shelf?
e.zh: 能把书架上那本蓝色的笔记本递给我吗?

lower.t:
v. 降低；放下
adj. 较低的

e.en: Please {lower} the volume; the baby is sleeping.
e.zh: 请把音量调小,宝宝在睡觉。

e.en: Prices are much {lower} during the summer sale.
e.zh: 夏季促销期间价格要低得多。

taxes.t:
n. 税款（复数）
v. 征税（第三人称）

e.en: Don't forget to file your {taxes} before April 15.
e.zh: 别忘了在4月15日前申报税务。

e.en: The city raised property {taxes} to fund new schools.
e.zh: 市政府提高了房产税以资助新建学校。

will.t:
aux. 将，会
n. 意志；遗嘱

e.en: I {will} call you as soon as I land.
e.zh: 我一落地就会给你打电话。

e.en: She has a strong {will} and never gives up.
e.zh: 她意志坚强,从不放弃。

e.en: Tax cuts are meant to {stimulate} consumer spending.
e.zh: 减税的目的是刺激消费支出。

e.en: Puzzles {stimulate} the brain and improve memory.
e.zh: 益智游戏能刺激大脑、增强记忆力。

e.en: Real estate is often considered a safe long-term {investment}.
e.zh: 房地产通常被视为一种安全的长期投资。

e.en: Learning a new language requires significant {investment} of time.
e.zh: 学习一门新语言需要投入大量时间。

e.en: New policies aim to {ameliorate} working conditions in the factory.
e.zh: 新政策旨在改善工厂的工作条件。

e.en: A warm meal can {ameliorate} the misery of a cold day.
e.zh: 一顿热饭能缓解寒冷天气带来的不适。

bill.t:
n. 账单；法案；钞票
v. 开账单；宣传

e.en: Could we have the {bill}, please? We need to leave.
e.zh: 麻烦结账好吗?我们要走了。

e.en: Congress is debating a new climate {bill} this week.
e.zh: 国会本周正在辩论一项新的气候法案。

faces.t:
n. 脸（复数）
v. 面对（第三人称单数）

e.en: The crowd had thousands of unfamiliar {faces}.
e.zh: 人群中有成千上万张陌生的面孔。

e.en: Every founder {faces} doubt at some point.
e.zh: 每位创业者都会在某个时刻面临怀疑。

e.en: Learning a new language is {difficult} but rewarding.
e.zh: 学习一门新语言很难,但很值得。

e.en: He can be {difficult} to work with when stressed.
e.zh: 他在压力大时会变得难以相处。

path.t:
n. 路径；小路
n. (文件) 路径

e.en: We followed a narrow {path} through the forest.
e.zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路穿过森林。

e.en: She chose a different career {path} after graduation.
e.zh: 毕业后她选择了一条不同的职业道路。

through.t:
prep. 穿过；通过
adv. 从头到尾

e.en: We walked {through} the park on the way home.
e.zh: 我们回家路上穿过了那座公园。

e.en: She read {through} the entire report before the meeting.
e.zh: 她在会议前把整份报告从头到尾读了一遍。

e.en: The {fractious} toddler refused to put on his shoes.
e.zh: 那个爱闹脾气的小孩不肯穿鞋。

e.en: Coalition talks grew {fractious} after the budget leak.
e.zh: 预算外泄后联合谈判变得越来越火爆。

polarized.t: adj. 极化的；两极分化的

e.en: The country has rarely been more {polarized} than it is today.
e.zh: 这个国家很少像今天这样两极分化。

e.en: {Polarized} lenses cut down reflections off water and snow.
e.zh: 偏光镜片能减少水面和雪面的反光。

e.en: The state {legislature} convenes every January in the capital.
e.zh: 州议会每年一月在首府召开。

e.en: A bill must pass both chambers of the {legislature}.
e.zh: 法案必须在立法机关的两院都获得通过。

where.t:
adv. 在哪里
conj. 在…的地方

e.en: Do you know {where} the nearest pharmacy is?
e.zh: 你知道最近的药店在哪里吗？

e.en: This is the cafe {where} we first met.
e.zh: 这就是我们第一次见面的那家咖啡馆。

e.en: The bill faced strong {opposition} from environmental groups nationwide.
e.zh: 该法案遭到全国环保组织的强烈反对。

e.en: The {opposition} party criticized the government's handling of inflation.
e.zh: 反对党批评政府对通货膨胀的处理。

e.en: {Lawmakers} debated the climate bill late into the night.
e.zh: 议员们就气候法案辩论到深夜。

e.en: State {lawmakers} voted to expand broadband access in rural areas.
e.zh: 州议员们投票决定扩大农村地区的宽带接入。

have.t: v. 有、拥有；(助动词) 构成完成时

e.en: Do you {have} a moment to discuss the project?
e.zh: 你有空讨论一下这个项目吗?

e.en: We {have} already finished all the assigned homework.
e.zh: 我们已经把布置的作业都做完了。

e.en: He {vowed} to never lie to his partner again.
e.zh: 他发誓再也不对伴侣撒谎了。

e.en: The mayor {vowed} to clean up the city's parks.
e.zh: 市长承诺要整治市内的公园。

e.en: Don't park here — you'll {obstruct} the fire exit.
e.zh: 别停在这里,你会挡住消防通道的。

e.en: Lawmakers tried to {obstruct} the bill with endless amendments.
e.zh: 议员们试图用无休止的修正案来阻挠这项法案。

e.en: The cat licked {its} paws after the meal.
e.zh: 那只猫吃完饭后舔了舔自己的爪子。

e.en: The company changed {its} logo last year.
e.zh: 公司去年更换了它的标志。

e.en: Read the highlighted {passage} aloud to the class.
e.zh: 请把高亮的那段文字大声读给全班听。

e.en: A narrow {passage} led down to the cellar.
e.zh: 一条狭窄的通道通向地下室。

e.en: I went to the concert {with} my younger sister.
e.zh: 我和妹妹一起去了那场演唱会。

e.en: She spread the toast {with} a thick layer of jam.
e.zh: 她在吐司上抹了厚厚的一层果酱。

e.en: The debate turned into a {vituperative} shouting match.
e.zh: 那场辩论沦为了一场谩骂式的争吵。

e.en: He deleted his {vituperative} post the next morning.
e.zh: 第二天早上他删掉了那条恶语相向的帖子。

floor.t:
n. 地板；楼层
v. 击倒；难倒

e.en: Please don't leave wet towels on the bathroom {floor}.
e.zh: 请不要把湿毛巾留在浴室地板上。

e.en: Her office is on the fifteenth {floor} of the building.
e.zh: 她的办公室在大楼的十五层。

e.en: The senator gave several {speeches} during the campaign tour.
e.zh: 那位参议员在竞选巡回中发表了多次演讲。

e.en: His political {speeches} are known for being short and sharp.
e.zh: 他的政治演讲以简短犀利著称。

e.en: {Despite} the rain, the concert went ahead as planned.
e.zh: 尽管下雨,演唱会仍按计划进行。

e.en: She got the job {despite} having no formal degree.
e.zh: 尽管没有正式学位,她还是得到了那份工作。

e.en: The announcement caused a {flurry} of activity on social media.
e.zh: 这则公告在社交媒体上引发了一阵热议。

e.en: A light {flurry} of snow dusted the rooftops.
e.zh: 一阵小雪轻轻覆盖了屋顶。

grassroots.t:
adj. 草根的；基层的
n. 基层民众

e.en: The campaign began as a small {grassroots} movement.
e.zh: 这场运动最初只是一场小规模的草根运动。

e.en: Real change often starts at the {grassroots} level.
e.zh: 真正的变革往往始于基层。

rhetoric.t: n. 修辞、华丽辞藻；花言巧语

e.en: His campaign speeches were full of fiery {rhetoric} but few details.
e.zh: 他的竞选演讲充满激烈的辞令,却没什么实质内容。

e.en: She studied classical {rhetoric} as part of her philosophy degree.
e.zh: 她在攻读哲学学位时学习了古典修辞学。

recent.t: adj. 最近的；新近发生的

e.en: Have you read any {recent} news about the merger?
e.zh: 你看过最近关于这次并购的新闻吗?

e.en: A {recent} study found coffee may improve focus slightly.
e.zh: 最近一项研究发现咖啡可能会略微提升注意力。

polls.t: n. 民意调查；投票（poll 复数）

e.en: Recent {polls} show the candidate gaining ground.
e.zh: 最近的民调显示这位候选人支持率上升。

e.en: Voters lined up at the {polls} before sunrise.
e.zh: 选民在日出前就在投票站排起了长队。

e.en: Recent studies {indicate} that exercise improves memory.
e.zh: 近期研究表明，运动能改善记忆力。

e.en: Please {indicate} your preferred meeting time on the form.
e.zh: 请在表格上注明您方便的会议时间。

e.en: Young {voters} turned out in record numbers this year.
e.zh: 今年年轻选民的投票人数创下历史新高。

e.en: Many {voters} are concerned about rising housing costs.
e.zh: 许多选民对不断上涨的住房成本感到担忧。

e.en: Please {remain} seated until the plane comes to a stop.
e.zh: 请保持就座,直到飞机完全停稳。

e.en: Only a few cookies {remain} in the jar.
e.zh: 罐子里只剩下几块饼干了。

e.en: He was {deeply} moved by the speech.
e.zh: 他被那段演讲深深打动。

e.en: Breathe {deeply} and try to relax.
e.zh: 深呼吸，试着放松。

e.en: I'm {skeptical} that the new feature will ship on time.
e.zh: 我怀疑这个新功能能不能按时上线。

e.en: She gave him a {skeptical} look and changed the subject.
e.zh: 她怀疑地看了他一眼,转而换了话题。

what.t:
pron. 什么
adj. 多么

e.en: {What} are you planning to do this weekend?
e.zh: 你这个周末打算做什么?

e.en: I don't know {what} she meant by that comment.
e.zh: 我不知道她那句评论是什么意思。

e.en: {They} are launching the new app next week.
e.zh: 他们下周将推出这款新应用。

e.en: Ask whoever called and see what {they} want.
e.zh: 问问打电话的人,看看他们想要什么。

view.t:
v. 查看；浏览
n. 视图；观点

e.en: The hotel room has a stunning {view} of the ocean.
e.zh: 这间酒店房间能看到壮丽的海景。

e.en: In my {view}, remote work boosts productivity.
e.zh: 在我看来,远程办公能提升效率。

e.en: The manager gave a {perfunctory} apology and moved on.
e.zh: 经理敷衍地道了个歉就把话题带过去了。

e.en: His {perfunctory} review missed several obvious bugs.
e.zh: 他敷衍的审查漏掉了好几个明显的漏洞。

e.en: Both sides made {concessions} to reach the deal.
e.zh: 双方都做出让步以达成协议。

e.en: We bought popcorn at the {concessions} stand.
e.zh: 我们在小卖部买了爆米花。

leaving.t:
v. 离开（-ing 形式）
n. 离去

e.en: I'm {leaving} for the airport in ten minutes.
e.zh: 我十分钟后就要去机场了。

e.en: Thanks for {leaving} the lights on for me.
e.zh: 谢谢你给我留着灯。

e.en: Trade {negotiations} between the two countries broke down.
e.zh: 两国之间的贸易谈判破裂了。

e.en: The union entered {negotiations} with management this morning.
e.zh: 工会今早开始与资方进行谈判。

e.en: Please handle this box carefully—it contains {fragile} glassware.
e.zh: 请小心搬运这个箱子，里面装着易碎的玻璃器皿。

e.en: The ceasefire remains {fragile} despite weeks of negotiation.
e.zh: 尽管谈判数周，停火仍然脆弱。

e.en: Salary talks reached an {impasse} after six long hours.
e.zh: 薪资谈判在漫长的六小时后陷入僵局。

e.en: Both sides need to compromise to break this {impasse}.
e.zh: 双方都需要妥协,才能打破这一僵局。
